animations.name: fadeIn
animations.css: @keyframes fadeIn { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
animations.description: Elements fade in and slide up from below, used for scroll-triggered content reveals

animations.description: Animated width progress indicator under tabs, JS-driven via inline style width percentage updates

insights: The design system uses a highly restrained grayscale palette with subtle translucent overlays (#F7F7F7/5, white/75) to create depth without introducing color complexity.
Button hierarchy is clearly defined through background fills: solid dark (#262626) for primary actions, light gray (#EEF1F5) for secondary, and transparent with outline for tertiary/ghost states.
Motion is primarily JS-driven (marquee, tab progress) rather than CSS keyframes, allowing for precise control over timing and state synchronization with interactive elements.
